# Turn an Fiverr transaction history into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Turn a Fiverr earnings history into month-split journal entries and see what Fiverr really cost you. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
